---
title: "How fast is R?"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
m <- REF_MACHINE
tl <- D$release_timeline[D$release_timeline$machine == m, ]
tl <- tl[order(tl$date), ]
base_v <- D$baselines[[m]]$version
```

```{r}
div(class = "rs-card",
  div(class = "rs-card-title", "Speedup across releases"),
  div(class = "rs-card-sub",
      sprintf("Geometric mean over %d benchmarks; higher is faster.", tl$n[1])),
  machine_tabs(D$machines$machine, function(mm) {
    t <- D$release_timeline[D$release_timeline$machine == mm, ]
    plot_release_timeline(t, D$baselines[[mm]]$version)
  })
)
```

```{r}
st <- D$suite_timeline[D$suite_timeline$machine == m, ]
div(class = "rs-card",
  div(class = "rs-card-title", "By suite"),
  div(class = "rs-card-sub", machine_label(m)),
  plot_suite_lines(st, base_v, height = 340)
)
```

## Recent changes in R-devel

```{r}
#| eval: !expr "!HAS_DEVEL"
not_yet("No R-devel nights measured under this methodology version yet.")
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr HAS_DEVEL
nights <- utils::head(devel_nights(D$changes), 5)
nights$status <- vapply(nights$kind, function(k) as.character(status(k)), "")
rs_table(
  data.frame(Night = fmt_date(nights$date), Revision = paste0("r", nights$svn_rev),
             Status = nights$status, Benchmarks = nights$n,
             `Largest change` = paste(fmt_speedup(nights$worst), "·", fmt_change(nights$worst)),
             check.names = FALSE),
  columns = list(Status = colDef(html = TRUE)),
  pagination = FALSE
)
```

[All R-devel nights →](devel.qmd)

::: {.rs-notes}
- `r nrow(D$benchmarks)` benchmarks, `r n <- length(unique(D$runs$version[D$runs$kind == "release"])); paste(n, ngettext(n, "R release", "R releases"))``r if (HAS_DEVEL) " and every night of R-devel" else ""`, on dedicated machines.
- 1× is **R `r base_v`**, the R in `r lts_name(base_v)` LTS, on the same machine. The geometric mean uses only benchmarks every release can run. [Methodology](methodology.qmd)
:::
